items.context:
MIST SPA emits ultra-fine bubbles smaller than one micrometre in size which intermittently collide with dirt on the skin surface. Dirt is lifted from the skin surface upon impact, and the next drop of water repels the floating dirt. It has stronger sebum removal power than the original spray type of our showers.

MIST SPA is the ideal mode for users who enjoy cleansing their face when having shower. The strength of the mist can be fine-tuned by adjusting the flow rate with the shower mixer while in use.
